title: Design a ChatGPT-Scale Conversational Assistant
subtitle: SSE token streaming, KV-cache & PagedAttention, TPM rate limiting, guardrails & SLM fallback
functionalReqs: Stream real-time LLM responses token-by-token over Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Maintain multi-turn conversation history across devices while respecting model context limits.
Enforce user/org TPM (Tokens Per Minute) + RPM quotas and safety guardrails.
Maintain high responsiveness via semantic caching, model routing, and graceful degradation under GPU saturation.

nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Users perceive streaming chat as frozen if first token lags >500ms.
Faster than human reading speed for fluid UX.
GPU clusters dominate COGS; naive KV padding wastes >60% VRAM.

workedSummary.tokenThroughput: 15,000 QPS × 1,000 avg tokens ≈ 15M tokens/sec total (input + output)!
workedSummary.gpuSizingContext: Sizing is bound by HBM VRAM (model weights + per-request KV-cache) and decode memory bandwidth—not CPU!

coreEntities.name: TokenQuotaBucket
coreEntities.storageEngine: Redis Cluster (Atomic Lua Dual Bucket: RPM + TPM)

apiContracts.purpose: Submit prompt turn, validate guardrails/TPM, and open Server-Sent Events token stream
Fetch persisted multi-turn history and branch tree

explorerTopology.title: ChatGPT-Scale Inference & Streaming Pipeline
explorerTopology.subtitle: TPM reservation -> Context assembly -> Semantic cache -> vLLM PagedAttention SSE stream
explorerTopology.overview: Unlike CRUD apps scaled around stateless CPU and SQL read replicas, a ChatGPT-scale assistant scales around **token budgets, context-window compaction, prefix/KV-cache reuse, continuous GPU batching, and graceful SLM degradation**.
keyTakeaways: SSE outperforms raw WebSockets for LLM streaming because generation is unidirectional per turn and traverses standard HTTP/2 L7 proxies cleanly.
Reserve estimated prompt + max output tokens upfront in Redis TPM bucket, then refund unused tokens when stream finishes.
Continuous batching + PagedAttention eliminates idle GPU bubbles and KV-cache fragmentation.

nodes.label: Web / Mobile Client
nodes.summary: Renders streamed markdown tokens progressively and caches partial turns locally.
failureModes: Browser disconnect mid-stream wastes GPU cycles unless Gateway cancels upstream RPC

nodes.label: AI Gateway + TPM Limiter
nodes.summary: Authenticates user, checks dual RPM/TPM quotas in Redis Lua, and runs fast input safety classifiers.
whenToUse: Protecting finite GPU clusters from token exhaustion
failureModes: Rate-limiting only by RPM lets a 128k-token prompt starve the GPU pool

nodes.label: Chat Orchestrator
nodes.summary: Loads recent turns, compacts older history via rolling summary, checks semantic cache, and routes to frontier vs SLM.
failureModes: Naive sliding window drops important early instructions unless pinned

nodes.label: Conversation Store + Cache
nodes.summary: Persists conversation turns asynchronously once stream completes and caches active session context.
failureModes: Persisting per-token to DB would crush IOPS—buffer full turn in memory and flush on completion/abort

nodes.label: KV-Aware Inference Scheduler
nodes.summary: Routes multi-turn follow-ups to the GPU replica already caching that conversation's KV prefix blocks.
whenToUse: Cutting TTFT prefill latency by 3x–5x on multi-turn chats
failureModes: Overloaded sticky worker requires queue-depth spill-over

nodes.label: GPU Inference Pool (H100)
nodes.summary: Runs iteration-level continuous batching + PagedAttention non-contiguous KV blocks; falls back to SLM on saturation.
failureModes: Client disconnect without abort leaves phantom token decoding burning GPU

chaosScenarios.title: Long-Context Prefill Spike + Disconnected Client Cleanup
chaosScenarios.triggerSummary: Surge of 100k-token document uploads causes prefill latency spikes while mobile users close tabs mid-stream.
chaosScenarios.mitigationSummary: Disaggregated Prefill vs Decode pods isolate long-prompt compute from streaming tokens; cancellation propagation frees orphaned KV blocks instantly.

steps.info: Client closed SSE socket -> Gateway fires gRPC cancel -> GPU frees 140 MB KV-cache immediately
steps.payloadInspector: ContextCancelled -> PagedAttention deallocates physical KV blocks & refunds unused TPM
steps.inspectorNote: Without cancellation propagation, abandoned requests continue burning H100 cycles until max_tokens.

steps.info: Heavy prefill isolated from decode fleet; queue > threshold downshifts simple queries to quantized 8B SLM
steps.payloadInspector: Decode ITL stays < 25ms (45+ TPS) for active streams during heavy prefill spike
steps.inspectorNote: Separating compute-bound Prefill nodes from memory-bandwidth-bound Decode nodes stops long prompts from stuttering active streams.

pros: Easy L7 load balancing & proxy traversal
cons: Half-duplex per request (user sends next turn as a fresh POST)
Sticky socket state complicates autoscaling & draining

deepDives.title: PagedAttention & Continuous Batching
deepDives.bottleneck: Static batching waits for the longest response in a batch to finish, and contiguous KV allocation wastes 60%+ VRAM via fragmentation.
deepDives.solution: Schedule at iteration (token) granularity—inserting new requests as soon as one finishes—and store KV tensors in virtual-memory-style non-contiguous blocks.
deepDives.tradeoff: Increases scheduler complexity, yet boosts GPU throughput 4x–10x.

deepDives.title: Deterministic Safety & Token Accounting
deepDives.bottleneck: LLM responses are non-deterministic in length, making upfront rate limits inaccurate and risking prompt-injection / PII leaks.
deepDives.solution: Reserve conservative `input + max_output` tokens upfront, reconcile delta at `[DONE]`, and wrap LLM calls behind deterministic moderation & policy filters.
deepDives.tradeoff: Small guardrail classifier hop (~10ms) added to TTFT in exchange for compliance and cost protection.

criteria: Defines TTFT, TPS, TPM, and HBM VRAM constraints
Designs TPM + RPM dual rate limiter with reserve/refund
Compacts history without blowing context windows
Routes multi-turn requests for prefix cache affinity
Propagates client abort to cancel GPU decode
Proposes SLM fallback & safety filters under load
